_doc: Merge into the project's .claude/settings.json. The hooks that wire Claude to the shared engine: every guarded tool call is piped to claude/shim.mjs (deny/inject engine), and every prompt is piped to both shim.mjs AND compact-monitor.mjs (threshold + PreCompact block for non-Claude proxies). Path assumes the adapter ships at .ai-dev/tooling/src/adapter/ — rewrite it if vendored elsewhere. See INSTALL.md.
